title: Alliance of Interest
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's slender fingers picked up a pitch-black Jade Pendant, its surface covered with mottled ancient characters that seemed alive, writhing faintly in the candlelight.

text.content: Midnight. The moonlight like frost. At the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his robes fluttering in the mountain wind. His gaze fell upon the distant Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, his eyes reflecting dots of eerie phosphorescent green light—the unique Spiritual Light of Demonic Path disciples. 'They came fast.' Chen Ji murmured to himself, the corners of his lips lifting slightly, yet showing no hint of a smile. Ye Qing had arrived half an hour earlier than he anticipated. It seemed the Demonic Path was more eager about this cooperation than he had imagined. Only time would reveal whether this urgency stemmed from genuine intent or concealed schemes.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Gongzi has refined taste, sitting alone on the cliff at midnight. Are you waiting for me on Tianqing Sect's territory, or waiting for something else?' A cold female voice came from behind, carrying a hint of mockery. Chen Ji didn't turn around—he had sensed her presence three breaths before Ye Qing even landed. Though the Holy Sect's 'Shadowstep' was eerie, it couldn't escape those eyes that had been repeatedly tempered by the Tianji Record. 'Since the Night Saint has arrived, please show yourself.' Chen Ji said calmly. 'Speaking from behind is rather fitting for how people of the Demonic Path conduct themselves.'

text.content: Before the words even finished, a slender black shadow had already swept to Chen Ji's side. Ye Qing wore a dark purple long dress, her face veiled, revealing only a pair of bewitching eyes. Her aura was perfectly restrained—if not for Chen Ji's perception amplified by the Tianji Record Fragment, he could hardly detect her existence. 'With the 'waste' persona you've maintained for so long, Brother Chen's tongue has grown quite sharp.' Ye Qing stopped three steps from Chen Ji. 'I've come today; surely you've already guessed the reason.' Chen Ji finally turned around, his gaze calmly falling upon Ye Qing. 'The quota for exploring the ancient ruins as a team is indeed tempting. But the Night Saint should know that Tianqing Sect and the Demonic Path are enemies. You and I cooperating is no different than making a pact with a tiger.'

dialogue.content: 'Making a pact with a tiger?' Ye Qing laughed lightly, though the笑意 didn't reach her eyes. 'Brother Chen, your words are quite wounding. My Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' intelligence, in exchange for an exploration quota—is this deal not fair enough?' Chen Ji's brow center stirred slightly. Heavenly Fate Lock Key—these four words were like a needle, piercing the softest part of his heart. Sister Chen Nian. His sister who had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect with no news since. And the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was precisely the crucial clue he had been desperately searching for. 'The Night Saint's information is quite well-informed.' Chen Ji's voice remained calm; only he himself knew that his fingertips had already begun trembling slightly. 'Even matters concerning my Chen family are clearly investigated.'

text.content: Ye Qing caught the fleeting abnormality in Chen Ji, a flash of understanding flickering in her eyes. She stepped forward, closing the distance to within two steps, the cold demonic fragrance from her body overwhelming. 'Why must Brother Chen play the fool? We are both intelligent people—that volume of Tianji Fragment... does the Holy Sect really know nothing about it?' Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Here it comes, he thought secretly. Indeed, from the beginning, the Demonic Path's objective had never been merely some ancient ruins or team exploration. The Tianji Record—this was their true target. But his expression remained unruffled; he merely narrowed his eyes slightly. 'The Night Saint's words must be weighed carefully. The three characters 'Tianji Record,' when spoken aloud in such a setting, can cost someone their head.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words pointed directly at the Tianji Record, and Chen Ji had to make a choice between maintaining the secret and obtaining intelligence.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly. 'Since the Night Saint has taken the conversation this far, it would be uninteresting for Chen to continue playing the fool. Very well, the Tianji Record is indeed in my possession, but it's incomplete—the Heavenly Secrets it can reveal are extremely limited.' His tone wascalmly to the point of being arrogant, as if discussing something trivial. 'If the Holy Sect wants it, take it—if you have the ability to snatch it from me.'

Probably few in the entire Holy Sect have seen its true form. You claim to know where it is—could the Holy Sect's higher-ups have become so bored that they need to verify a legend on a Servant Disciple?' He stepped forward, staring directly at Ye Qing. 'Instead, I should ask—what promises has the Holy Sect made to the Night Saint, that you're willing to be this sword that probes the way?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji seemed not to hear Ye Qing's words, turning to gaze at the churning sea of clouds below the cliff: "What are the specific conditions of cooperation, Saint Maiden Ye?" His voice was flat as if discussing today's weather. "The quota for group exploration, intelligence about the Heavenly Fate Key... With such an offer from the Holy Sect, surely they don't just want to befriend a servant disciple?" Ye Qing's brow slightly furrowed at Chen Ji's noncommittal attitude. She realized thistrashdisciple was far more troublesome than the rumors suggested.

Ye Qing's eyes narrowed slightly. Chen Ji's response clearly exceeded her expectations. Thistrashlaborer... no, his performance was nothing like that of atrash. She reassessed the young man before her. "Lord Chen is indeed as troublesome as the rumors suggest." Ye Qing abandoned her probing demeanor, her tone becoming formal. "Since Lord Chen wants to hear the truth, I'll speak directly. The Holy Sect does have designs on the Tianji Record, but my visit tonight has nothing to do with the sect's high-level authorities." She paused, carefully choosing her words. "I need to enter that ancient ruins to find a method to remove the restriction on my body. And you - need my intelligence to find your missing sister. This transaction is mutually fair."

text.content: Chen Ji noticed the change in Ye Qing's wording. "Removing the restriction" - these four characters revealed far more than surface meaning. A Holy Sect Saint Maiden, despite her high position, was actually bound by some kind of restriction. What did this imply? His mind raced rapidly. The Tianji Record Fragment deep in his consciousness pulsed with warmth, signaling that this woman carried secrets worth noting. He recalled Master Mo's words - "The Demonic Path's mist can obscure the Tianji Record's aura." This precisely represented the value of his cooperation with Ye Qing. But obscuring aura... whose aura was being concealed? Merely Chen Ji's own, or including all traces of Ye Qing herself?

dialogue.content: "Your gaze has changed, Lord Chen." Ye Qing suddenly spoke, breaking Chen Ji's train of thought. She stepped forward again, close enough that Chen Ji could see the vaguely visible line of her collarbone beneath the veil. "What are you thinking? How to use me, or what exactly the Holy Sect did to me?" Chen Ji did not retreat, meeting her gaze directly: "Both." His frankness momentarily startled Ye Qing, before she laughed softly: "Interesting. Chen Ji, you are nothing like the rumoredtrash."

text.content: "Rumors are never entirely reliable." Chen Ji said calmly. "Take you, Saint Maiden Ye - a Holy Sect Saint Maiden yet seeking help from atrashlike me to remove a restriction. If this got out, it would be far more shocking than my reputation as atrash." Ye Qing's smile froze. She hadn't anticipated Chen Ji would so directly expose her vulnerable situation. A prestigious Demonic Path Saint Maiden, yet shackled by a restriction, needing external assistance - should this spread, her revered name would suffer significantly. "Lord Chen is rather... ruthless in his assessments," Ye Qing's voice cooled. "It seems tonight's negotiations will require renegotiating the terms."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly said: "Saint Maiden Ye, if you want the restriction removed, I can help you." Ye Qing's gaze froze: "What did you say?" Chen Ji looked directly into her eyes: "Although the Tianji Record is fragmented, the power to glimpse Heavenly Secrets might reach the restriction's origin. We each take what we need, why should we mutual guard?" Ye Qing fell silent. She hadn't expected Chen Ji to proactively propose such terms - this meant he had, to some extent, revealed his reliance on the Tianji Record. "You... are you serious?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, his aura rising sharply: "Saint Maiden Ye, do you think the restriction on your body is merely a means for the Holy Sect to control you?" His voice was low, carrying an indescribable implication. "Soul-Devouring Seal - it strikes once every day at midnight, excruciating pain, worse than death. If I guess correctly, you have at most three years to live." Ye Qing's face instantly paled. She hadn't expected Chen Ji to instantly name the restriction, let alone that he knew the timing of its strikes so precisely. "You... how do you know?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not respond, simply gazing quietly at Ye Qing. After a moment, he spoke, his voice unhurried: "Saint Maiden Ye says you know the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fate Key, Chen is very interested. But empty words easily cause unease." He extended one hand, palm up. "How about this - the Saint Maiden first tells me one piece of intelligence about the 'Heavenly Fate Key', as a gesture of sincerity. If Chen finds it worthwhile, then we can discuss cooperation." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "You certainly don't stand on ceremony." Though she said this, she did not refuse, clearly also evaluating the feasibility of this transaction.

Ye Qing was silent for a long while, moonlight falling on her veil, outlining a faintly visible contour. Finally, she spoke, her voice several degrees lower than before: "The Heavenly Fate Key is the key to opening the 'Heavenly Fate Altar.' And that altar lies at the bottom of the 'Abyssal Depths' at the junction of your three major sects." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. The Abyssal Depths - that was a forbidden dead land that the three sects explicitly prohibited entering, rumored to seal the remnant soul of an ancient Demon God. He hadn't expected his sister Chen Nian to be connected to such forbidden grounds. "What else?" Chen Ji pressed. Ye Qing's lips curved into a meaningful arc: "There's one more thing - opening the altar requires two Heavenly Fate Keys to be present simultaneously. Chen Nian... is only one of them."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart racing. Two Heavenly Fate Lock Keys—this meant that besides Chen Nian, another person had been chosen as a Lock Key. Who was this person? What was their relationship with Chen Nian? Enemy or ally? The Tianji Record Fragment flashed wildly in the depths of his consciousness, attempting to deduce the possibilities of the future. However, every time Chen Nian's face emerged in those visions, everything became blurred, as if an invisible barrier was obstructing his foresight. Chen Nian's existence was indeed interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight—this was a fact he had already confirmed. But was this a good thing or a bad thing? "Who is the other Heavenly Fate Lock Key?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice, the uncontrollable urgency in his voice drawing Ye Qing's sidelong glance.

dialogue.content: "This question is not within the scope of what I intend to discuss tonight." Ye Qing shook her head, a hint of cunning flickering in her eyes. "Young Master Chen, I have shown sufficient sincerity. Now, it's your turn." Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Indeed, he could not appear too eager, otherwise it would only give Ye Qing leverage to raise her price. He glanced around, confirming no third pair of eyes was watching, before speaking: "Fine. We cooperate." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, waiting for his follow-up. "But I have three conditions." Chen Ji held up three fingers. "First, the ancient intelligence in your hands must be completely disclosed to me, with no concealment. Second, during the relic exploration, you shall be responsible for concealing the traces and aura of both parties. Third—" he paused, his gaze sharp as a blade. "If my sister suffers even a single mishap, Saint Ye will become my mortal enemy."

text.content: Ye Qing listened quietly to Chen Ji's three conditions, her face betraying no emotions. After a long while, she suddenly laughed lightly: "Young Master Chen is indeed no ordinary man. The first and second conditions are perfectly reasonable, but this third one..." Her gaze turned playful. "Are you warning me, or are you telling me that you actually care deeply about that sister who has been missing for years?" Chen Ji did not answer, simply staring at her in silence. Ye Qing stepped forward, closing the distance between them to just one step. She raised her hand, and her slender fingers gently touched Chen Ji's chest: "Very well, I agree. But Young Master Chen should also remember—while you are using me, don't forget that we are on the same boat. If the boat capsizes, no one will survive."

choice.prompt: The cooperation agreement had been initially reached, and Chen Ji needed to decide on the next course of action.

dialogue.content: ""Since we've agreed to cooperate, we must have a way to communicate." Chen Ji retrieved an ordinary transmission talisman from his sleeve. "This is the standard item used by servant disciples at Tianqing Sect. The spiritual energy fluctuation is weak, making it difficult to detect. If you have urgent matters, just activate it with spiritual energy." Ye Qing took the talisman but did not put it away immediately. Instead, after examining it for a moment, she suddenly leaned close to Chen Ji's ear and whispered: "Young Master Chen is quite cautious. However... if you need to transmit confidential messages next time, this thing won't be enough." She took out a jet-black jade pendant from her sleeve and stuffed it into Chen Ji's hand. "This is the 'Soul Nether Command,' a token of the Holy Sect's upper echelons. At critical moments, it can save your life."

dialogue.content: ""We've said enough for tonight." Chen Ji extended the transmission talisman toward Ye Qing. "You keep it first; there's no rush for contact. In three days, at the 'Withered Vine Valley' east of Tianqing Sect, I will take you to meet someone." Ye Qing took the talisman, her brow slightly raised: "Meet whom?" Chen Ji did not answer directly, only turning to gaze at the sea of clouds below the cliff: "A person who can reassure Saint Ye and make you feel at ease cooperating with us." His back in the moonlight appeared especially lonely, yet exuded a composure that others dared not underestimate. Ye Qing stared at his back for a long while, finally turning into a soft sigh: "Chen Ji... just how many secrets are you still hiding?"

dialogue.content: ""Since cooperation is set, the specific details must be implemented." Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his tone carrying a hint of indisputable authority. "Within half a month, I need to complete the arrangements within the sect. At that time, I will leave Tianqing Sect under the pretext of 'gathering herbs.' You, after making your arrangements, notify me through the transmission talisman." Ye Qing listened quietly, her gaze becoming increasingly complicated. Thistrashdisciple... no, this person before her was clearly someone accustomed to giving orders from a position of authority. She had seen too many powerhouses at the Holy Sect, yet rarely had anyone maintained such composure before her. "Half a month..." Ye Qing softly repeated. "Young Master Chen is indeed calm and steady. For others, they would probably want to set out tomorrow."

text.content: Chen Ji turned around upon hearing this, his gaze falling on Ye Qing. Moonlight poured down, shrouding her in a hazy aura, momentarily making it hard for him to distinguish whether before him was a real woman or yet another illusion woven by fate. "What's the point of being impatient?" he said lightly. "The ancient relics are fraught with unpredictable dangers; rushing in blindly would only lead to death. Half a month is enough for both of us to prepare adequately." Ye Qing gazed at him deeply, then suddenly smiled: "Chen Ji, you are indeed different from the rumors. No wonder the Holy Sect values you so much—even I have become curious whether the Tianji Record falling into your hands is a blessing or a curse." Chen Ji did not respond. He simply stood there quietly, letting the mountain wind flutter his robes, while in his heart he rapidly calculated each step of the chess game ahead.

dialogue.content: ""By the way, there's one more thing." Ye Qing suddenly spoke, interrupting Chen Ji's thoughts. She retrieved a jet-black jade pendant from her sleeve, its surface covered with mottled patterns, and faint ancient writings could be seen faintly glowing. "This is the 'Heavenly Fate Mark' recorded in the Holy Sect's classics, with an indescribable connection to the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys." She extended the jade pendant toward Chen Ji. "I originally planned to present this as tonight's token of sincerity, but after thinking about it, it's better to give it to you inside the relic." Ye Qing pinched the jade pendant with her slender fingers, waving it before Chen Ji. "After all—the remuneration for having the Demonic Path Saint personally run errands can't be too cheap, can it?" Her smile in the moonlight appeared especially eerie, yet carried an enticing allure that sent chills down one's spine.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the jade pendant, his pupils contracting sharply. Heavenly Fate Mark—he had heard this name from Mo Xiansheng. It was said to be a relic left behind by a great power from ancient times, capable of sensing the existence of those with Heavenly Fate. If what Ye Qing said was true, this jade pendant would be of immeasurable value in his search for his sister Chen Nian. But at the same time, a trace of vigilance rose in Chen Ji's heart. People of the Demonic Path always act for profit's sake. For Ye Qing to be willing to offer such a treasure as a cooperation筹码, there was only one possibility—the things she sought in the relic were far more precious than this jade pendant. "Saint Ye is quite generous." Chen Ji's voice wascalm得听不出任何波澜, "But one should not accept gifts without earning them. I'll keep this for now; if the need arises later, I'll repay the favor." He extended his hand and accepted the jade pendant. The moment it touched his palm, a strange force surged through his fingertips into his body, causing him to involuntarily shiver.

As soon as the jade pendant touched his hand, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment tremble violently in the depths of his consciousness. Countless blurred images flooded in like a tide—ancient altars, swirling smoke, two figures bound by chains... But everything was broken, distorted, as if seen through a thick curtain of water. He desperately tried to make out the details of those images, yet each time he attempted to focus, his vision would plunge into chaos. 'What did you see?' Ye Qing's voice rang in his ear, carrying a hint of inquiry. Chen Ji snapped back to reality, only to find that at some point he had already gripped the jade pendant tightly, his palm covered with fine cold sweat. '...Nothing.' He took a deep breath and stored the jade pendant in his sleeve. 'Just not accustomed to the aura of Demonic Path treasures.' Ye Qing gave him a knowing look but didn't press further.

The night wind grew colder, and the atmosphere at the Cliff Edge became subtle. Ye Qing withdrew her inquisitive gaze and turned to look toward the distant Tianqing Sect. 'It's getting late, I should leave.' She paused, then added, 'In three days at Withered Vine Valley, or half a month later at the Abyss of Shadows—Young Master Chen, don't keep me waiting too long.' Before her words even faded, her form had already turned into a black shadow, merging into the night, vanishing in an instant. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, gazing in the direction Ye Qing had disappeared, long without moving. Tonight's negotiation far exceeded his expectations—not only had he reached a cooperation agreement, but he had also unexpectedly obtained crucial intelligence about his sister Chen Nian, as well as that mysterious Heavenly Fate Mark.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his right hand. The force that had surged into his body when he held the jade pendant had now dissipated, but the Tianji Record Fragment remained faintly warm in the depths of his consciousness, seeming to transmit some kind of message. 'Heavenly Fate Lock and Key... altar... and another Lock and Key...' he murmured to himself, sorting through the information he had obtained tonight one by one. His sister Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect was no coincidence. She was one of the two keys to open the Heavenly Fate Altar. And the master of the other key remained a mystery. The Holy Sect's desire to open the altar undoubtedly pointed to some greater scheme. Ye Qing, as a Saint, needed external assistance to remove her own restriction, which suggested her position within the Holy Sect was far less favorable than it appeared on the surface. Was this cooperation a mutually beneficial transaction, or merely a small element in a much larger Chess Game?

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing the power of the Tianji Record to flow through his consciousness. Tonight's foresight had cost him five points of Heavenly Fate Value, but this deal... was worth it. His sister's whereabouts now had a lead, intelligence about the ancient ruins was within reach, and he even had the opportunity to gain the assistance of a Demonic Path Saint. Although he knew that cooperating with the Demonic Path was no different from playing with fire, on the path of pursuing the complete Tianji Record and uncovering the truth of destiny, sometimes necessary sacrifices were unavoidable. 'Chen Nian...' Chen Ji softly spoke this name, a rare gentleness flickering in his eyes. 'Wait for me. Whatever the cost, I will find you.' The night wind scattered his words and also dispersed the last trace of relaxation around him. In the next moment, Chen Ji's gaze turned cold and sharp once more, as if the tenderness from moments before had merely been an illusion. He turned toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect, his silhouette stretching long under the moonlight, like a sword about to be drawn from its sheath.

When he returned to the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, the east was already brightening with the first light of dawn. Chen Ji pushed open the door of his dilapidated little room, only to find a note had somehow appeared on his table. The note contained only four characters, the handwriting graceful yet carrying a hint of sharpness—'Back Mountain Bamboo Grove.' Su Qingyao. Chen Ji's gaze slightly hardened. The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the number one prodigy of the Tianqing Sect, and the only person who had repeatedly sensed something amiss about him. Three times she had come infinitely close to the truth, three times he had deflected her—this was the cat-and-mouse game between him and Su Qingyao. Yet now, this 'cat' seemed ready to pounce again. He carefully stored the note away, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of his mouth. It seemed the days ahead would not be peaceful.
